faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Dima Hasao District Court Driver Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Driver on contingency basis post is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed at least the VIII standard and possess a valid LMV Driving License to be eligible for the Driver on contingency basis position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Driver on contingency basis post?
faq.answer: The age limit for this recruitment is between 18 years and 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Driver position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed pay of Rs. 15,000/- per month for the Driver on contingency basis role.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Driver post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Driver on contingency basis in the Dima Hasao District Court.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for the Driver on contingency basis post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Driving Test followed by an Interview/Viva-voce to assess the candidates' suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Dima Hasao District Court: https://dimahasao.dcourts.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates, as specified in the official notification.
